name: design-critic-loop
description: Raise any design to a high bar with the Gauntlet Loop: instead of letting the generator grade its own homework, spin up independent fresh-context critics (brief / system / craft) that judge against an explicit definition of done and iterate until they pass. Starts by pinning down what 'done' means — asking the user for goals and reference examples when the bar is unclear — then loops build→critique→fix until it converges. Reusable by any design skill.
